description:
Adds a Disabled option to SwiftKey's Gesture input setting, disabling both Flow and keyboard gestures.

Supports Microsoft SwiftKey 9.13.20.4 and 9.13.19.3.

patches.name: Gesture input: Disabled
patches.description: Adds a Disabled option to Gesture input, turning off both Flow and keyboard gestures.

release_notes:
Fixes Morphe Manager reporting **0 patches**.

The release MPP now contains classes.dex, which Manager on Android loads. This also fixes the build ordering that let generatePatchesList overwrite the DEX-enabled MPP.

Adds a **Disabled** option to Microsoft SwiftKey's Gesture input setting.

Supported versions:
- 9.13.20.4
- 9.13.19.3
